expectations.text: 상태(Status)와 진료과(Department) 모두 TextChoices 클래스로 정의한다
expectations.evidence: models.py: Appointment.Status(models.TextChoices) at line 92, Doctor.Department(models.TextChoices) at line 43. Both are properly defined as TextChoices classes.

expectations.text: 같은 의사-시간대 중복 방지에 clean() + UniqueConstraint 이중 검증을 적용한다
expectations.evidence: models.py: clean() calls _validate_no_duplicate_schedule() (line 156-173) for application-level validation, and UniqueConstraint on ['doctor','scheduled_at'] with condition excluding cancelled (line 126-130) for DB-level enforcement. Both layers present.

expectations.text: 상태 전이 로직(confirm/complete/cancel)이 모델 메서드에 있고, 뷰는 위임만 한다
expectations.evidence: models.py: confirm() (line 175), complete() (line 181), cancel() (line 187) are model methods with status guard checks. views.py: change_status action (line 71-94) delegates via action_map[action_name]() calling the model methods directly without reimplementing transition logic.

expectations.text: DRF Serializer가 최소 list/detail/create 3개로 분리되고 get_serializer_class()를 오버라이드한다
expectations.evidence: serializers.py defines AppointmentListSerializer (line 27), AppointmentDetailSerializer (line 55), AppointmentCreateSerializer (line 82) -- three distinct serializers. views.py: get_serializer_class() overridden at line 38-45 dispatching by self.action (list/create/change_status/default-detail).

expectations.text: config/ + apps/ 구조에 settings가 base/local/production으로 분리되고 django-environ을 사용한다
expectations.evidence: structure.md confirms config/settings/{base,local,production,test}.py and apps/ directory. settings_base.py: 'import environ' (line 5), env = environ.Env() (line 9), environ.Env.read_env() (line 12), env('DJANGO_SECRET_KEY') (line 14), env.db('DATABASE_URL') (line 64). local.py and production.py both import from .base.
